name: watch.file
description: Subscribe to filesystem changes (file create / modify / delete) matching a glob. Emits EVENT frames per change until the subscription is cancelled.

glob.description: Filesystem glob pattern. Wildcards: `*` (any chars in a single path component), `?` (single char). The agent watches the glob's parent directory and filters notifications against the pattern.

recursive.description: If true, watch the parent directory's entire subtree (changes in any descendant directory match if the relative path matches the glob).

x-event-schema.description: EVENT frames emitted per filesystem change matching the glob.

path.description: Absolute path of the changed file.

old_path.description: Old path. Only present when `kind` is `renamed`; absent for other event kinds.

x-implementations.name: read_directory_changes_w
x-implementations.description: Win32 `ReadDirectoryChangesW(FILE_NOTIFY_CHANGE_FILE_NAME | LAST_WRITE | SIZE)` on the glob's parent directory. NT 5+. Filters incoming FILE_NOTIFY_INFORMATION records against the glob pattern in the agent's callback.

x-implementations.name: find_first_change_notification
x-implementations.description: Legacy fallback for NT 4 / 9x where ReadDirectoryChangesW is unavailable. Less granular — provides directory-level change events without per-file detail; agent re-scans the directory on each notification.

windows-modern.description: ReadDirectoryChangesW with FILE_NOTIFY_* flags covering name / write / size changes. Renames within the watched directory are reported as a single `renamed` event with `old_path` populated; renames across directory boundaries surface as a `deleted` + `created` pair.

windows-classic.description: ReadDirectoryChangesW on NT 5+ (XP onwards); FindFirstChangeNotification + re-scan loop on NT 4 / 9x. The fallback path produces only `created` / `deleted` events (no granular `modified` or `renamed` differentiation).
